# RPC API alignment and "finalized" param for subscriptions

## Pull Request by @skoszuta

- added placeholders for new unimplemented methods
- updated subscriptions to feature the "finalized" param

the API should now fully align with https://github.com/polkadot-fellows/JIPs/blob/main/JIP-2.md

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Eight new RPC endpoints added as placeholders: workReport, submitWorkPackageBundle, workPackageStatus, syncState, subscribeSyncStatus, subscribeWorkPackageStatus, fetchWorkPackageSegments, fetchSegments.
  * Subscription input formats updated: service data, preimage, request, value, and statistics subscriptions now use revised parameter ordering and include a finalized flag.

* **Refactor**
  * RPC server and subscription flow reworked to decouple validation from handler execution and to use explicit output schemas.

* **Tests**
  * End-to-end subscription tests updated to use the new validation and handler-level error injection.

<sub>✏️ Tip: You can customize this high-level summary in your review settings.</sub>

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Walkthrough

This PR adds eight new notImplemented RPC handlers to the exported handlers map and revamps subscription flows: multiple subscribe-* handlers now use an explicit subscribe API that accepts a handler and an output schema, select block context (best vs finalized), and map events into dedicated handlers. The change updates server call handling to pass handler and output schema, shifts subscription storage to include handler/outputSchema, updates validation schemas (including new notImplemented schemas), and adapts e2e tests to the new subscription/validation signatures.

- FluffyLabs/typeberry#765: Introduced notImplemented handlers and corresponding validation schema entries similar to those added here.
